title: Owl Semaphore Badge System
description: Owl Semaphore v2.0.0. Refines the METACOGNITIVE interpretive phrasing to 'The observer audits the frame' (deprecating 'This audits the standard'), reconciles the canonical formal sentence onto 'A finite algebra over epistemic states, implemented as a reproducible visual notation system with enforced invariants', makes the accessibility rule (color is not the only carrier; state identity is recoverable from color + orientation + textual label) normative, adds an explanation document with the DNS Tool origin story and archetype rationale, ships a single-command reproducible PDF pipeline with per-page owl headers and embedded PDF metadata, adds a CHANGELOG with the canonical sentence per version, populates SHA-3-512 hashes for tracked specifications and PDFs, and adds a banner-tuple integrity test that verifies state, transform, determinant, mapping, version, and DOI family from generated PDFs. The Klein-four-group (V4) algebra and the sigma_h assignment to METACOGNITIVE are unchanged from v1.2.0. v2.0.0 version DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20418539.
